name: paper-review
description: Review selected paper content while stating what material was actually available and retaining locators.

# Paper review

- First classify the source as metadata-only, abstract-only, full-text, or extraction-incomplete.
- Read only user-selected material through the document tools or notebook. Do not fetch inaccessible content or bypass a login.
- For every reported finding, retain page/paragraph/section locators and quote only as much as needed.
- Separate a paper's claims, methods, results, limitations and your interpretation. Do not infer causal strength from bibliographic metadata.
- Note missing sections, extraction problems, retractions/updates that are actually verified, and contradictions across sources.
- If only an abstract is available, title the result as an abstract-based review.
